Class MarkdownInlineRenderer

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.markdown.internal.MarkdownInlineRenderer
public final class MarkdownInlineRenderer extends Object
Renders the inline children of a markdown block node into a list of width-fitted Lines. Style is composed top-down as the visitor descends into emphasis, strong, code, and link nodes.

  • Method Details

    • render

      public static List<Line> render(org.commonmark.node.Node parent, Style baseStyle, int maxWidth, MarkdownStyles styles, Overflow overflow)
      Renders the inline children of parent into lines using the given overflow strategy.
      Parameters:
      parent - the block node whose inline children should be rendered
      baseStyle - the style applied to plain text (e.g. heading style)
      maxWidth - target width in columns; values <= 0 produce an empty list
      styles - the style palette
      overflow - how to handle lines wider than maxWidth
      Returns:
      a list of lines that all fit within maxWidth

    • renderSpans

      public static List<Span> renderSpans(org.commonmark.node.Node parent, Style baseStyle, MarkdownStyles styles)
      Walks the inline children of parent and emits a list of plain styled spans (without wrapping). Useful for table cells where wrapping is delegated to the Table widget.
      Parameters:
      parent - the block node whose inline children should be rendered
      baseStyle - the base style applied to plain text
      styles - the style palette
      Returns:
      a list of spans flattened from the inline children
